# gstack

> gstack is Garry's Stack: AI engineering workflow skills and a design CLI. This file indexes every capability so agents can discover and invoke them without crawling individual SKILL.md files.

Conventions:
- Skills are invoked by name (e.g. `/ship`, `/plan-ceo-review`).
- Design commands run as `design <command> [args]` (or `$D`).
- Project-specific config lives in `CLAUDE.md`. Always read it first.

## Skills

- [/autoplan](autoplan/SKILL.md): Review a plan through applicable product, design, DX, and engineering perspectives; stop at the plan.
- [/benchmark](benchmark/SKILL.md): Performance regression detection.
- [/browse](browse/SKILL.md): Drive the browser supplied by the user's agent host: open a page, read it, click through a flow, take screenshots, and check console errors.
- [/build](build/SKILL.md): Implement an approved change, including focused regression checks and a reviewable diff.
- [/canary](canary/SKILL.md): Post-deploy canary monitoring.
- [/careful](careful/SKILL.md): Safety guardrails for destructive commands.
- [/context](context/SKILL.md): Save working state, restore it against the current checkout, or manage project learnings.
- [/context-restore](context-restore/SKILL.md): Resume a saved task against the current checkout.
- [/context-save](context-save/SKILL.md): Save this task and its evidence for later work.
- [/design](design/SKILL.md): Create a design system, compare visual variants, or produce Pretext-native HTML and CSS.
- [/design-consultation](design-consultation/SKILL.md): Propose a complete design system with a reviewable artifact.
- [/design-html](design-html/SKILL.md): Build responsive Pretext-native HTML and CSS.
- [/design-review](design-review/SKILL.md): Review and fix visual defects in an actual rendered UI.
- [/design-shotgun](design-shotgun/SKILL.md): Create distinct visual variants and a comparison board.
- [/deslop-shared-libs](deslop-shared-libs/SKILL.md): Find worthwhile shared-code extractions in recent work.
- [/devex-review](devex-review/SKILL.md): Measure installation, first success, and recovery in the actual developer flow.
- [/diagram](diagram/SKILL.md): Turn an English description (or mermaid source) into a diagram triplet: the source, an editable .excalidraw file you can open on excalidraw.com, and rendered SVG + PNG.
- [/document-generate](document-generate/SKILL.md): Generate missing documentation from scratch for a feature, module, or entire project.
- [/document-release](document-release/SKILL.md): Post-ship documentation update.
- [/freeze](freeze/SKILL.md): Restrict file edits to a specific directory for the session.
- [/gstack](gstack/SKILL.md): Router for the gstack skill suite.
- [/gstack-upgrade](gstack-upgrade/SKILL.md): Upgrade gstack to the latest version.
- [/guard](guard/SKILL.md): Full safety mode: destructive command warnings + directory-scoped edits.
- [/health](health/SKILL.md): Report current code-quality checks and tool gaps.
- [/investigate](investigate/SKILL.md): Systematic debugging with root cause investigation.
- [/ios-clean](ios-clean/SKILL.md): Remove the DebugBridge SPM package and all #if DEBUG wiring from an iOS app.
- [/ios-design-review](ios-design-review/SKILL.md): Visual design audit for iOS apps on real hardware.
- [/ios-fix](ios-fix/SKILL.md): Autonomous iOS bug fixer.
- [/ios-qa](ios-qa/SKILL.md): Live-device iOS QA for SwiftUI apps.
- [/ios-sync](ios-sync/SKILL.md): Regenerate the iOS debug bridge against the latest upstream gstack templates.
- [/land-and-deploy](land-and-deploy/SKILL.md): Land and deploy workflow.
- [/landing-report](landing-report/SKILL.md): Read-only queue dashboard for workspace-aware ship.
- [/learn](learn/SKILL.md): Search or manage project learnings.
- [/make-pdf](make-pdf/SKILL.md): Turn Markdown into print-ready HTML, then export a PDF through the user's host-provided browser when its tools support PDF printing.
- [/office-hours](office-hours/SKILL.md): Frame a product idea and write a short problem, approach, and non-goals document.
- [/plan](plan/SKILL.md): Frame a product idea, plan implementation, review an existing plan, or write an executable spec.
- [/plan-ceo-review](plan-ceo-review/SKILL.md): Review product scope, alternatives, and user value in an existing plan.
- [/plan-design-review](plan-design-review/SKILL.md): Review the UI and accessibility decisions in an existing plan.
- [/plan-devex-review](plan-devex-review/SKILL.md): Review installation, first success, and recovery in a developer-facing plan.
- [/plan-eng-review](plan-eng-review/SKILL.md): Review implementation architecture, failures, and tests in an existing plan.
- [/plan-tune](plan-tune/SKILL.md): Self-tuning question sensitivity + developer psychographic for gstack (v1: observational).
- [/qa](qa/SKILL.md): Reproduce and fix authorized browser defects, then rerun the failing flow.
- [/qa-only](qa-only/SKILL.md): Report browser defects with evidence; leave source and commits unchanged.
- [/retro](retro/SKILL.md): Weekly engineering retrospective.
- [/review](review/SKILL.md): Review a current diff for supported defects and release blockers.
- [/scrape](scrape/SKILL.md): Pull data from a web page through the browser supplied by the user's agent host.
- [/setup-deploy](setup-deploy/SKILL.md): Configure deployment settings for /land-and-deploy.
- [/ship](ship/SKILL.md): Prepare a release candidate, verify and review that candidate, then create or update its PR when authorized.
- [/spec](spec/SKILL.md): Write an executable spec; file an issue only when the user requested issue publication.
- [/sprint](sprint/SKILL.md): Carry one authorized task from scope through plan, implementation, verification, review, and optionally a pull request.
- [/unfreeze](unfreeze/SKILL.md): Clear the /freeze edit boundary when the user asks to unlock edits.
- [/verify](verify/SKILL.md): Verify the changed interface with executable evidence.
